selection_rule: Five outcome-selected test illustrations: a NanoJev-only success with an extended wait before its actual shot, a NanoJev-only success with early turns, a shared success, a NanoJev failure while both baselines succeed, and a shared failure. These illustrations do not estimate aggregate performance; the page also reports every one of the 128 frozen test cases and all 128 OOD cases separately.

cases.title: Wait for the window
cases.description: NanoJev waits while the target moves, then lands its one shot. Jev and Untuned Qwen fire earlier and miss.

cases.title: Turn into the shot
cases.description: NanoJev turns before firing and hits the moving target. Both comparison policies miss this seed.

cases.title: All three connect
cases.description: All three policies hit the target, with different shot timing.

cases.title: A miss to learn from
cases.description: Jev and Untuned Qwen hit this seed; NanoJev misses.

cases.title: A shared challenge
cases.description: All three policies spend their one shot without a hit.
